pre_install: if (-not ('ZarRs.CpuFeatures' -as [type])) { Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System.Runtime.InteropServices; namespace ZarRs { public static class CpuFeatures { [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] public static extern bool IsProcessorFeaturePresent(uint feature); } }' -ErrorAction Stop }
if (-not [ZarRs.CpuFeatures]::IsProcessorFeaturePresent(40)) { throw 'Windows could not confirm AVX2 support. Install the baseline zar-rs package instead.' }
